symbols.name: createSyncLifecycleScope
symbols.signature: export declare function createSyncLifecycleScope(options?: ISyncLifecycleScopeOptions): ISyncLifecycleScope;
symbols.purpose: Creates a resource owner whose release is fully synchronous. It accepts only explicit `syncSafe: true` descriptors and rejects asynchronous or provisional scope resources; accidental thenables produce synchronous `SCOPE_SYNC_VIOLATION`, with their captured then read once and late rejection sent to `report`, or the shared utils host exception queue without a reporter.
symbols.core:
An `ISyncLifecycleScope` supporting synchronous disposal and `Symbol.dispose` when available; a missing required reporter throws `INVALID_OPTION`.
errorPolicy: Selects the release error outcome from `LifecycleErrorPolicy`. Every admitted item still receives its release attempt; `report` and `firstError` require a reporter when creating a scope or transaction.
`throw`: rethrow one original failure or aggregate several after release.
Keep default throw to propagate release failures. Choose collect to inspect a returned list, report to deliver every failure to a required reporter, or firstError to throw the first and report later ones. Every item still receives its release attempt.
report: Receives each diagnostic or policy-routed `error` from lifecycle. Return nothing synchronously; accidental thenable rejections and synchronous throws are contained. A scope or transaction requires this callback for `report` and `firstError` policies.
report.error: Original failure or coded diagnostic supplied by the current lifecycle operation.
No value is consumed; callback failures do not replace the operation result.
Omitted: diagnostics have no sink; factories reject this omission for `report` and `firstError`.
Supply a synchronous receiver when cleanup failures must reach monitoring. It is required with report or firstError policies; omission otherwise provides no diagnostic sink. Return no value; reporter failures are contained.
parameters: options: ISyncLifecycleScopeOptions (optional)
symbols.returns: ISyncLifecycleScope
examples:
const scope = createSyncLifecycleScope()
scope.own(node, { syncSafe: true, force: () => node.detach() })
scope.close()
const failures = scope.dispose() // 同步返回

blocks.text: 按四种错误策略收集/上报错误，`createDisposeTransaction`/`createSyncLifecycleScope` 内部都用它：

`policy`、`report`（必填，`throw`/`collect` 可显式传 `undefined`；`report`/`firstError` 必须提供函数，否则创建时抛 `INVALID_OPTION`）。`add(source, error)` 按策略即时处理（`'report'` 策略立即调用 `report`；`'firstError'` 只记住第一个错误，其余经 `report` 观测）。`finalize(message)`：`'collect'` 返回收集到的数组；`'report'` 返回空数组（已在 `add` 时上报）；`'throw'` 单错保留原生实例并给未分类错误附 `SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED`，primitive 通过 cause 包装；已有合法外部身份不变。多错聚合成携带 `SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED` 码的 `AggregateError`；`'firstError'` 有错误时抛首个，否则返回空数组。

guidance.id: 方法调用-descriptor-与-options-的读取时机
guidance.heading: 方法调用、descriptor 与 options 的读取时机

blocks.text: `createLifecycleScope`、`createSyncLifecycleScope`、`createProvisionalScope` 和 `createMutationQueue` 返回的对象，方法都定义在原型上，必须通过对象调用（`scope.own(...)`、`queue.enqueue(...)`）。把方法解构出来单独调用（`const { own } = scope`）不受支持。
`own()` 校验 descriptor 时会保存一份快照，释放时使用的就是这份快照：注册之后再修改 descriptor 对象，或 getter 之后返回不同的值，都不会影响释放。provisional scope 在 `commitTo(parent)` 时仍把原 descriptor 交给 `parent.own()`，由父 scope 自己校验和快照。
options（`errorPolicy`、`report`、`deadlineAt`、`scheduler`、`onAdmissionDiagnostic` 等）只在创建时读取一次，之后不会再读。
释放回调收到的 `context.signal` 在第一次读取时才创建（已经处于 aborted 状态，reason 为 `SCOPE_CLOSED`）；provisional scope 没有传 `parentSignal` 时，它的 `signal` 也是第一次读取时才创建。不读取 signal 的释放回调不会产生 AbortController。

blocks.text: 按四种错误策略收集/上报错误，`createDisposeTransaction`/`createSyncLifecycleScope` 内部都用它：

`policy`、`report`（必填，`throw`/`collect` 可显式传 `undefined`；`report`/`firstError` 必须提供函数，否则创建时抛 `INVALID_OPTION`）。`add(source, error)` 按策略即时处理（`'report'` 策略立即调用 `report`；`'firstError'` 只记住第一个错误，其余经 `report` 观测）。`finalize(message)`：`'collect'` 返回收集到的数组；`'report'` 返回空数组（已在 `add` 时上报）；`'throw'` 单错保留原生实例并给未分类错误附 `SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED`，primitive 通过 cause 包装；已有合法外部身份不变。多错聚合成携带 `SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED` 码的 `AggregateError`；`'firstError'` 有错误时抛首个，否则返回空数组。

blocks.text: 稳定错误码表，22 个码，唯一声明处 `src/error-code.ts`，`source` 恒为 `'lifecycle'`：

rows: 相对延时无法注册、调度或清理；原错误保持可追溯，取消本身返回 false 而非错误
`close()` 之后调用 `own()`（异步/同步 scope）或某个 registry 的 `retain()`
容器已到达 `terminal` 之后，任何登记/激活操作
disposer 内部重入本 scope 的 `dispose()`
disposer 内部调用本 scope 的 `own()`
`SyncLifecycleScope` 收到 `syncSafe !== true` 的 descriptor、收到一个异步 scope 实例作为资源、或某回调返回了 thenable
`throw` 策略下释放失败：单个未分类失败会被附上此码，多个失败合成的 `AggregateError` 也带此码
由已不再导出的内部单元加载器使用
一次异步操作的结果在 `adopt()` 提交点已被更晚的 generation 取代（非失败信号，仅诊断）
generation 取消期间的 timer、parent listener 或 signal cleanup 失败
在已 `dispose()` 的 `GenerationController` 上调用 `begin()`
当前 generation 的 timeoutMs 预算到期；signal.reason 为带码 Error
未先 `seal(key)` 就调用严格 `whenZero(key)`（同步抛出，非 rejected Promise）
重复 commit、rollback 后 commit、成功 commit 后 rollback；重复 rollback 复用原 Promise
`commitTo()` 的目标 parent 已 `closing`/`terminal`，拒绝接收资源
mutation 在队列中等待超过配置的 `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs`
同一 `owner` 在自己尚未完成时又向同一队列提交新任务且被等待，会死锁
descriptor 的 `force` 抛出/reject（契约要求 `force` 必须无条件成功）
共享绝对 deadline 已过去，但仍有资源被要求进入新的 graceful 阶段；或同步 `graceful` 超过预算才返回（仍算成功，不跑 `force`）。两者都只经 `report` 上报，正常降级路径不用这个码
lifecycle 需要的宿主 `AbortController` 能力缺失；调度器宿主能力缺失由 utils `ENV_UNSUPPORTED` 报告
scheduler 收到非法时间/延迟参数，或 descriptor 字段类型非法

blocks.text: 逐条设计动机见源码 `src/error-code.ts` 的 JSDoc；调用方应始终以 `error.code === LifecycleErrorCode.xxx` 判别，不要硬编码码值字符串。

blocks.text: 通用异步所有权容器：
边界行为：

items: `own(resource, descriptor)`：容器处于 `closing`/`terminal` 时抛 `SCOPE_CLOSED`/`SCOPE_TERMINAL`；在 disposer 内部重入调用抛 `SCOPE_REENTRANT_OWN`；descriptor 形状非法（`order`/`custom`/`graceful`/`gracefulTimeoutMs`/`force`，规则同 dispose 时的 descriptor 校验）时在注册时就抛 `INVALID_OPTION`，访问器抛错则原样抛出。
`release(resource)`：反注册但不释放（调用方已自行释放），返回是否找到并移除了该条目；若曾设置 `gcFallback`，同时 unregister 对应的 `FinalizationRegistry` 条目。
`close()`：同步、幂等；`open → closing`。

`dispose()`：逆序（LIFO）释放全部已注册资源；并发多次调用复用同一个 Promise；需要在 disposer 中表达 owner self-join 时使用 `context.disposer.join()`，该操作抛 `SCOPE_REENTRANT_DISPOSE` 且不改变 canonical Promise；容器已 `terminal` 时仍返回首次 dispose Promise，保留原结果或 rejection。`errorPolicy: 'collect'` 时返回值为收集到的 `ICollectedError[]`；其余三种策略要么抛出要么内部上报，返回空数组。
提供 `[Symbol.asyncDispose](): Promise<void>`，可直接用于 `await using`（TypeScript 需包含 `ESNext.Disposable` 类型库）。

symbols.purpose: Caller-authored resource-release contract shared by scopes and transactions; callbacks express domain teardown while lifecycle owns order and error collection.
symbols.core:
syncSafe: Declares that all release callbacks finish synchronously. Required as `true` for the synchronous scope; it never changes an asynchronous scope into a synchronous one.
Omitted: not eligible for a synchronous scope.
Choose only for callbacks guaranteed to return no thenable.
Does not promise synchronous release; use the asynchronous scope.
order: Finite caller-defined release priority: larger values release first in order mode, while equal priorities preserve input sequence. Plan mode never reads it.
`0`: participates in the stable default-priority group.
graceful: Optional graceful callback receiving the current `IReleaseContext`. Return void or a thenable; success ends release, while throw/rejection records the original failure and proceeds to force. A timed-out thenable stays observed but is not cancelled.
graceful.context: Release context supplied by the executing scope or transaction.
Void or a thenable indicating graceful completion; timeout permits fallback without cancelling it.
Omitted: run `force` immediately unless `custom` overrides release.
gracefulTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative budget in milliseconds, measured before invoking graceful code and capped by the shared absolute deadline. A synchronous callback that returns late reports an overrun but still succeeds.
Omitted: only the shared deadline applies; without either limit the graceful phase has no time bound.
force: Required unconditional release callback receiving `IReleaseContext`. Return void or a thenable; its failure is collected and also reported as `RELEASE_FORCE_FAILED` with the original as cause.
force.context: Release context supplied by the scope, transaction or explicit descriptor execution.
Void or a thenable completing final teardown; callback failures do not prevent later items from releasing.
gcFallback: Requests best-effort finalization support for an object owned by an asynchronous scope. A reachable scope still strongly owns resources; explicit release unregisters the fallback. The synchronous scope ignores this flag.
`false`: no finalization registry registration is created.
custom: Takes over the entire release sequence with a caller-authored callback receiving `IReleaseContext`. Return void or a thenable; throws and rejections become item errors, and neither graceful nor force runs.
custom.context: The executing release owner supplies cancellation, deadline and diagnostics.
Void or a thenable completing the entire custom release.
Omitted: use the graceful-to-force sequence.

members.name: force
members.description: Forced release. Must complete unconditionally; must not throw a recoverable error.

A live scope strongly owns its resources, so this cannot collect an individual resource while its scope is reachable. It never replaces explicit disposal. SyncLifecycleScope accepts this shared descriptor field but does not register a finalizer.

blocks.text: 通用异步所有权容器：
边界行为：

items: `own(resource, descriptor)`：容器处于 `closing`/`terminal` 时抛 `SCOPE_CLOSED`/`SCOPE_TERMINAL`；在 disposer 内部重入调用抛 `SCOPE_REENTRANT_OWN`；descriptor 形状非法（`order`/`custom`/`graceful`/`gracefulTimeoutMs`/`force`，规则同 dispose 时的 descriptor 校验）时在注册时就抛 `INVALID_OPTION`，访问器抛错则原样抛出。
`release(resource)`：反注册但不释放（调用方已自行释放），返回是否找到并移除了该条目；若曾设置 `gcFallback`，同时 unregister 对应的 `FinalizationRegistry` 条目。
`close()`：同步、幂等；`open → closing`。

`dispose()`：逆序（LIFO）释放全部已注册资源；并发多次调用复用同一个 Promise；需要在 disposer 中表达 owner self-join 时使用 `context.disposer.join()`，该操作抛 `SCOPE_REENTRANT_DISPOSE` 且不改变 canonical Promise；容器已 `terminal` 时仍返回首次 dispose Promise，保留原结果或 rejection。`errorPolicy: 'collect'` 时返回值为收集到的 `ICollectedError[]`；其余三种策略要么抛出要么内部上报，返回空数组。
提供 `[Symbol.asyncDispose](): Promise<void>`，可直接用于 `await using`（TypeScript 需包含 `ESNext.Disposable` 类型库）。

blocks.text: 纯同步容器：

blocks.code:
const scope = createSyncLifecycleScope()
scope.own(node, { syncSafe: true, force: () => node.detach() })
scope.close()
const failures = scope.dispose() // 同步返回

blocks.text: 约束与边界：

items: 每个 descriptor 必须显式 `syncSafe: true`，否则 `own()` 在注册时（不是释放时）就抛 `SCOPE_SYNC_VIOLATION`。
descriptor 形状校验与异步版本相同：`order` 非有限数、`force` 缺失等非法值在 `own()` 时抛 `INVALID_OPTION`。
不能 `own()` 一个 `LifecycleScope`/`ProvisionalScope` 实例（内部品牌检测），命中同样抛 `SCOPE_SYNC_VIOLATION`。
某个 callback（`custom`/`graceful`/`force`）若返回 thenable，在释放当次同步探测到并抛 `SCOPE_SYNC_VIOLATION`（`graceful` 违规时会继续跑 `force`，`force`/`custom` 违规则该项失败计入当前错误策略）。
降级链与异步版本相同（`custom` → 否则 `graceful` → `force`），但没有超时竞速——没有可等待的对象。
`release()`/`close()` 语义与异步版本一致；`dispose()` 幂等，二次调用返回 `[]`；在 disposer 内部重入抛 `SCOPE_REENTRANT_DISPOSE`。
提供 `[Symbol.dispose](): void`，可直接用于 `using`（TypeScript 需包含 `ESNext.Disposable` 类型库）。

Required when `errorPolicy` * is `report` or `firstError`; otherwise the factory throws `INVALID_OPTION` with `detail.field: * 'report'`. */ readonly report?: (error: unknown) => void; };
symbols.purpose: Caller-owned configuration for synchronous release error delivery without asynchronous timing.
symbols.core:
errorPolicy: Selects the release error outcome from `LifecycleErrorPolicy`. Every admitted item still receives its release attempt; `report` and `firstError` require a reporter when creating a scope or transaction.
`throw`: rethrow one original failure or aggregate several after release.
Keep default throw to propagate release failures. Choose collect to inspect a returned list, report to deliver every failure to a required reporter, or firstError to throw the first and report later ones. Every item still receives its release attempt.
report: Receives each diagnostic or policy-routed `error` from lifecycle. Return nothing synchronously; accidental thenable rejections and synchronous throws are contained. A scope or transaction requires this callback for `report` and `firstError` policies.
report.error: Original failure or coded diagnostic supplied by the current lifecycle operation.
No value is consumed; callback failures do not replace the operation result.
Omitted: diagnostics have no sink; factories reject this omission for `report` and `firstError`.
Supply a synchronous receiver when cleanup failures must reach monitoring. It is required with report or firstError policies; omission otherwise provides no diagnostic sink. Return no value; reporter failures are contained.

symbols.name: ISyncReleaseDescriptor
symbols.signature: export type ISyncReleaseDescriptor = IReleaseDescriptor & { readonly syncSafe: true; };
symbols.purpose: Release descriptor accepted only when explicit `syncSafe: true` promises synchronous callbacks; inherited release semantics remain unchanged.
symbols.core:
syncSafe: Required literal true promising every release callback finishes synchronously; thenables violate the synchronous scope contract.
Omitted: not eligible for a synchronous scope.
Explicitly opts this descriptor into synchronous ownership admission.
order: Finite caller-defined release priority: larger values release first in order mode, while equal priorities preserve input sequence. Plan mode never reads it.
`0`: participates in the stable default-priority group.
graceful: Optional graceful callback receiving the current `IReleaseContext`. Return void or a thenable; success ends release, while throw/rejection records the original failure and proceeds to force. A timed-out thenable stays observed but is not cancelled.
graceful.context: Release context supplied by the executing scope or transaction.
Void or a thenable indicating graceful completion; timeout permits fallback without cancelling it.
Omitted: run `force` immediately unless `custom` overrides release.
gracefulTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative budget in milliseconds, measured before invoking graceful code and capped by the shared absolute deadline. A synchronous callback that returns late reports an overrun but still succeeds.
Omitted: only the shared deadline applies; without either limit the graceful phase has no time bound.
force: Required unconditional release callback receiving `IReleaseContext`. Return void or a thenable; its failure is collected and also reported as `RELEASE_FORCE_FAILED` with the original as cause.
force.context: Release context supplied by the scope, transaction or explicit descriptor execution.
Void or a thenable completing final teardown; callback failures do not prevent later items from releasing.
gcFallback: Requests best-effort finalization support for an object owned by an asynchronous scope. A reachable scope still strongly owns resources; explicit release unregisters the fallback. The synchronous scope ignores this flag.
`false`: no finalization registry registration is created.
custom: Takes over the entire release sequence with a caller-authored callback receiving `IReleaseContext`. Return void or a thenable; throws and rejections become item errors, and neither graceful nor force runs.
custom.context: The executing release owner supplies cancellation, deadline and diagnostics.
Void or a thenable completing the entire custom release.
Omitted: use the graceful-to-force sequence.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
lifecycle: Current survival state from `LifecycleState`; closing forbids new work and terminal is irreversible.
close: Idempotently changes open to closing; it performs no cleanup and preserves terminal state.
Admission state is closing unless it was already terminal.
forceTerminal: Idempotently marks terminal immediately and resolves all terminal waiters without running cleanup.
Terminal state is published and its retained promise is resolved.
whenTerminal: Returns the retained terminal promise. Pair with `forceTerminal()` to publish actual completion after the owner finishes cleanup.
The same `Promise<void>` on every call; it resolves once terminal is marked.

sections.title: 高阶用法
sections.content: Publish one terminal promise while the owning component performs its own resource cleanup.

Moves straight to `terminal`, resolving `whenTerminal()`. */ forceTerminal(): void; /** Resolves exactly once, when `terminal` is reached. */ whenTerminal(): Promise<void>; };

symbols.purpose: Stable semantic error-code table for lifecycle boundaries, diagnostics and cancellation reasons. Compare source first, then inspect the selected code and the retained original cause or aggregate errors.
symbols.core:
delayFailed: Delay registration, scheduling or cleanup failed; retain the original cause before retrying.
scopeClosed: A closing scope rejects ownership, or its closing signal carries this cancellation reason.
scopeTerminal: A terminal owner rejects further registration; construct a new owner.
scopeReentrantDispose: A disposer tries to dispose or join its own releasing scope; move that action outside release.
scopeReentrantOwn: A release callback tries to register new resources with its active owner, or reenters ledger admission.
scopeSyncViolation: A sync descriptor lacks `syncSafe: true`, owns an async scope or returns a thenable.
scopeDisposalFailed: Several release failures are exposed by an `AggregateError`; inspect every original in `errors`.
unitStartFailed: A lifecycle unit start throws or rejects; retained for the unit start boundary rather than scope ownership.
generationSuperseded: A newer generation replaces the active request, or stale adoption reports a discarded result.
generationCancellationFailed: Generation cancellation or completion cleanup failed after token invalidation; inspect retained causes.
generationDisposed: A disposed controller rejects `begin()`; also identifies a disposed unit’s generation cancellation.
generationTimedOut: The per-generation timeout expires and aborts its signal; create a fresh request to retry.
quiescenceSealed: A sealed key rejects a new retain; finish admission before sealing.
quiescenceUnsealedWait: Strict zero waiting ran before sealing and throws synchronously; seal first or use the loose wait.
provisionalSettled: A provisional scope was reused after commit or rollback, or its signal reports that settlement.
provisionalParentClosed: Commit target refused ownership as closed or terminal; uncompensated resources are released before rejection.
queueAdmissionTimeout: A queued task exceeded its caller-selected admission budget and was removed without running.
queueSelfDependency: A task submits work with the currently running owner label; the successor is rejected to prevent self-wait.
releaseForceFailed: Forced release throws or rejects; the diagnostic retains the original resource failure as cause.
deadlineExceeded: Graceful work exceeded its budget or began after the shared deadline; this is a diagnostic.
envUnsupported: The host lacks a compliant native `AbortController`; use a supported execution realm.
invalidOption: A scheduler, descriptor, delay, cleanup result or required reporter violates its boundary contract.
parameters: This const declaration has no parameters.

members.description: An abortable delay cannot register, schedule, or clean up its owned wait resources. Enforces * Retain the original failure while the owner decides whether to retry or stop. Cancellation * itself resolves the wait and does not use this code.

members.name: scopeClosed
members.description: Reports `own()` after `close()`, or `retain()` on a closed registry. The container no longer * accepts work. Create a new scope instead of reusing it. Enforces the two-phase contract: * `close()` changes state synchronously, cannot fail, and does not call user code. Also tags the * `signal.reason` of a `LifecycleScope`/`SyncLifecycleScope` aborted by `close()` or `dispose()`, * so cancelled work observes a coded Error with a stack instead of a string.

members.name: scopeTerminal
members.description: Rejects registration or activation after `dispose()` reaches `terminal`. This is stronger than * `SCOPE_CLOSED` because `terminal` is irreversible. Create a new container instead of retrying.

members.name: scopeReentrantDispose
members.description: Reports a disposer reentering its own scope's `dispose()`. The error propagates through the * triggering disposer's normal error path. Other resources still finish releasing. Move this * cleanup outside the disposer so a resource does not dispose the scope releasing it.

members.name: scopeReentrantOwn
members.description: Reports a disposer synchronously calling its own scope's `own()`. The error belongs to the * triggering disposer, as with reentrant disposal. The container is already `closing`. It cannot * take ownership of new resources during release. Outside that synchronous callback frame, a * caller observes `SCOPE_CLOSED` while teardown is pending.

members.name: scopeSyncViolation
members.description: Rejects a descriptor without `syncSafe: true` at registration in `SyncLifecycleScope`. Also * rejects a `LifecycleScope` or `ProvisionalScope` instance as an owned resource. The check runs * at registration, before release. Use an asynchronous `LifecycleScope`, or explicitly mark a * suitable descriptor `syncSafe: true`. Its `force` and `graceful` callbacks must never return a * thenable.

members.name: scopeDisposalFailed
members.description: Classifies untagged release failures in every error policy and aggregates multiple failures * under the throw policy. Native single failures retain identity; primitives retain cause. * Existing foreign semantic identities remain unchanged. Inspect cause/errors for originals.

members.name: unitStartFailed
members.description: Reports a start failure when `LifecycleUnit` enters `failed`. The failure can be a synchronous * throw or a rejected thenable. Call `start()` or `restart()` to retry with a new generation. * Call `close()` to stop new work and `dispose()` to reach `terminal`. The `failed` state still * permits these transitions.

members.name: generationSuperseded
members.description: Identifies a result discarded at commit because a newer generation supersedes it. This is * normal race handling rather than an operation failure. Callers usually ignore it unless * diagnostics need to observe the event. Also tags the `signal.reason` of a generation aborted * because `begin()` started a newer one, so cancelled work observes a coded Error with a stack.

members.name: generationCancellationFailed
members.description: Reports timer, parent-listener, or signal cleanup failure during generation cancellation or * completion. Invalidation first converges state, then preserves cleanup failures in registration * order. Enforces generation supersession. Handle the error and use a new generation. Do not * revive the old generation.

members.name: generationDisposed
members.description: Rejects `begin()` on a disposed `GenerationController`. The controller cannot be reused. Create * a new controller. Also tags the `signal.reason` of the active generation aborted when a * `LifecycleUnit` is disposed; the work it carried must stop and is not retried.

members.name: generationTimedOut
members.description: Tags the `signal.reason` of a generation aborted because its `begin({ timeoutMs })` budget * elapsed. The generation is no longer current; start a new generation to retry, or raise the * budget. Not thrown by the controller itself; consumers see it through the aborted signal.

members.name: quiescenceSealed
members.description: Rejects `retain()` after `seal()`. Sealing stops new leases. Finish retaining before sealing, * or use the nonexclusive `whenZeroOnce()` path.

members.name: quiescenceUnsealedWait
members.description: Rejects strict `whenZero(key)` synchronously when `seal(key)` has not run. It does not return a * rejected Promise. Strict zero-lease waiting first stops new leases so its guarantee holds. Call * `seal()` first, or use `whenZeroOnce()` and perform the second check yourself.

members.name: provisionalSettled
members.description: Rejects `own()` or `commitTo()` after a provisional scope commits or rolls back. Also rejects * `rollback()` after a successful commit. Repeated rollback reuses the same Promise, including * rollback after failed-commit compensation. Commit and rollback are alternative terminal * actions. Check callers that try to register or commit again. Also tags the provisional * `signal.reason` aborted by `commitTo()` or `rollback()`; the message names which one.

members.name: provisionalParentClosed
members.description: Reports `commitTo()` when the target parent is `closing` or `terminal` and refuses ownership. * Resources already transferred remain owned by the parent. This call releases the remaining * resources automatically. The caller does not need to call `rollback()` manually.

members.name: queueAdmissionTimeout
members.description: Rejects and removes a mutation that waits longer than `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs`. This admission * timeout is configurable and does not apply when omitted. Check for an earlier task blocking the * queue, or increase the threshold.

members.name: queueSelfDependency
members.description: Rejects a submission whose owner label matches the currently running mutation's owner. The * check does not depend on whether the caller awaits the submitted task. Awaiting a successor * inside that mutation would deadlock the FIFO queue. Avoid waiting for another queued task with * the same owner. Split the work into separate top-level calls when needed.

members.name: releaseForceFailed
members.description: Reports a throw or rejection from a descriptor's `force` callback. The contract requires * `force` to finish unconditionally. The current error policy collects or reports the failure, * and release still reaches `terminal`. Treat it as an unrecoverable resource-leak risk rather * than a transient failure to retry.

members.name: deadlineExceeded
members.description: Identifies a new graceful phase requested after the shared absolute deadline passes, or a * synchronous `graceful` that returned only after its budget (that release still succeeds and * `force` does not run). Both are reported through `context.report` as diagnostics, never thrown. * Normal graceful-timeout fallback to `force` is a degradation path and does not use this code.

members.name: envUnsupported
members.description: Reports a missing or noncompliant host `AbortController` through the abort factory. Scope, * generation, and disposal paths fail immediately when they need that capability. Missing * scheduler capabilities are reported by `@migaia/utils/scheduler` as utils `ENV_UNSUPPORTED`. * Use an environment with `AbortController`, or an API that does not require it.

members.name: invalidOption
members.description: Rejects invalid scheduler/task options and failures of admitted scheduler methods (including * task cancel/unref) at the lifecycle boundary. Native failures retain identity when annotatable. * Examples include throwing accessors, missing `now`, `schedule`, or `cancel`, and a nonfunction * `unref`. Also rejects nonfinite time values, nonfinite or negative delays, addition that * overflows, or cleanup observations without the error array required by `mergeCleanupResults`. * Enforces scheduler admission and finite nonnegative delays. Correct the scheduler or delay * instead of retrying the same invalid input.

Also tags the * `signal.reason` of a `LifecycleScope`/`SyncLifecycleScope` aborted by `close()` or `dispose()`, * so cancelled work observes a coded Error with a stack instead of a string. */ readonly scopeClosed: 'SCOPE_CLOSED'; /** * Rejects registration or activation after `dispose()` reaches `terminal`. This is stronger than * `SCOPE_CLOSED` because `terminal` is irreversible. Create a new container instead of retrying. */ readonly scopeTerminal: 'SCOPE_TERMINAL'; /** * Reports a disposer reentering its own scope's `dispose()`. The error propagates through the * triggering disposer's normal error path. Other resources still finish releasing. Move this * cleanup outside the disposer so a resource does not dispose the scope releasing it. */ readonly scopeReentrantDispose: 'SCOPE_REENTRANT_DISPOSE'; /** * Reports a disposer synchronously calling its own scope's `own()`. The error belongs to the * triggering disposer, as with reentrant disposal. The container is already `closing`. It cannot * take ownership of new resources during release. Outside that synchronous callback frame, a * caller observes `SCOPE_CLOSED` while teardown is pending. */ readonly scopeReentrantOwn: 'SCOPE_REENTRANT_OWN'; /** * Rejects a descriptor without `syncSafe: true` at registration in `SyncLifecycleScope`. Also * rejects a `LifecycleScope` or `ProvisionalScope` instance as an owned resource. The check runs * at registration, before release. Use an asynchronous `LifecycleScope`, or explicitly mark a * suitable descriptor `syncSafe: true`. Its `force` and `graceful` callbacks must never return a * thenable. */ readonly scopeSyncViolation: 'SCOPE_SYNC_VIOLATION'; /** * Classifies untagged release failures in every error policy and aggregates multiple failures * under the throw policy. Native single failures retain identity; primitives retain cause. * Existing foreign semantic identities remain unchanged. Inspect cause/errors for originals. */ readonly scopeDisposalFailed: 'SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED'; /** * Reports a start failure when `LifecycleUnit` enters `failed`. The failure can be a synchronous * throw or a rejected thenable. Call `start()` or `restart()` to retry with a new generation. * Call `close()` to stop new work and `dispose()` to reach `terminal`. The `failed` state still * permits these transitions. */ readonly unitStartFailed: 'UNIT_START_FAILED'; /** * Identifies a result discarded at commit because a newer generation supersedes it. This is * normal race handling rather than an operation failure. Callers usually ignore it unless * diagnostics need to observe the event. Also tags the `signal.reason` of a generation aborted * because `begin()` started a newer one, so cancelled work observes a coded Error with a stack. */ readonly generationSuperseded: 'GENERATION_SUPERSEDED'; /** * Reports timer, parent-listener, or signal cleanup failure during generation cancellation or * completion. Invalidation first converges state, then preserves cleanup failures in registration * order. Enforces generation supersession. Handle the error and use a new generation. Do not * revive the old generation. */ readonly generationCancellationFailed: 'GENERATION_CANCELLATION_FAILED'; /** * Rejects `begin()` on a disposed `GenerationController`. The controller cannot be reused. Create * a new controller. Also tags the `signal.reason` of the active generation aborted when a * `LifecycleUnit` is disposed; the work it carried must stop and is not retried. */ readonly generationDisposed: 'GENERATION_DISPOSED'; /** * Tags the `signal.reason` of a generation aborted because its `begin({ timeoutMs })` budget * elapsed. The generation is no longer current; start a new generation to retry, or raise the * budget. Not thrown by the controller itself; consumers see it through the aborted signal. */ readonly generationTimedOut: 'GENERATION_TIMED_OUT'; /** * Rejects `retain()` after `seal()`. Sealing stops new leases. Finish retaining before sealing, * or use the nonexclusive `whenZeroOnce()` path. */ readonly quiescenceSealed: 'QUIESCENCE_SEALED'; /** * Rejects strict `whenZero(key)` synchronously when `seal(key)` has not run. It does not return a * rejected Promise. Strict zero-lease waiting first stops new leases so its guarantee holds. Call * `seal()` first, or use `whenZeroOnce()` and perform the second check yourself. */ readonly quiescenceUnsealedWait: 'QUIESCENCE_UNSEALED_WAIT'; /** * Rejects `own()` or `commitTo()` after a provisional scope commits or rolls back. Also rejects * `rollback()` after a successful commit. Repeated rollback reuses the same Promise, including * rollback after failed-commit compensation. Commit and rollback are alternative terminal * actions. Check callers that try to register or commit again. Also tags the provisional * `signal.reason` aborted by `commitTo()` or `rollback()`; the message names which one. */ readonly provisionalSettled: 'PROVISIONAL_SETTLED'; /** * Reports `commitTo()` when the target parent is `closing` or `terminal` and refuses ownership. * Resources already transferred remain owned by the parent. This call releases the remaining * resources automatically. The caller does not need to call `rollback()` manually. */ readonly provisionalParentClosed: 'PROVISIONAL_PARENT_CLOSED'; /** * Rejects and removes a mutation that waits longer than `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs`. This admission * timeout is configurable and does not apply when omitted. Check for an earlier task blocking the * queue, or increase the threshold. */ readonly queueAdmissionTimeout: 'QUEUE_ADMISSION_TIMEOUT'; /** * Rejects a submission whose owner label matches the currently running mutation's owner. The * check does not depend on whether the caller awaits the submitted task. Awaiting a successor * inside that mutation would deadlock the FIFO queue. Avoid waiting for another queued task with * the same owner. Split the work into separate top-level calls when needed. */ readonly queueSelfDependency: 'QUEUE_SELF_DEPENDENCY'; /** * Reports a throw or rejection from a descriptor's `force` callback. The contract requires * `force` to finish unconditionally. The current error policy collects or reports the failure, * and release still reaches `terminal`. Treat it as an unrecoverable resource-leak risk rather * than a transient failure to retry. */ readonly releaseForceFailed: 'RELEASE_FORCE_FAILED'; /** * Identifies a new graceful phase requested after the shared absolute deadline passes, or a * synchronous `graceful` that returned only after its budget (that release still succeeds and * `force` does not run). Both are reported through `context.report` as diagnostics, never thrown. * Normal graceful-timeout fallback to `force` is a degradation path and does not use this code. */ readonly deadlineExceeded: 'DEADLINE_EXCEEDED'; /** * Reports a missing or noncompliant host `AbortController` through the abort factory. Scope, * generation, and disposal paths fail immediately when they need that capability. Missing * scheduler capabilities are reported by `@migaia/utils/scheduler` as utils `ENV_UNSUPPORTED`. * Use an environment with `AbortController`, or an API that does not require it. */ readonly envUnsupported: 'ENV_UNSUPPORTED'; /** * Rejects invalid scheduler/task options and failures of admitted scheduler methods (including * task cancel/unref) at the lifecycle boundary. Native failures retain identity when annotatable. * Examples include throwing accessors, missing `now`, `schedule`, or `cancel`, and a nonfunction * `unref`. Also rejects nonfinite time values, nonfinite or negative delays, addition that * overflows, or cleanup observations without the error array required by `mergeCleanupResults`. * Enforces scheduler admission and finite nonnegative delays. Correct the scheduler or delay * instead of retrying the same invalid input. */ readonly invalidOption: 'INVALID_OPTION'; };

blocks.text: 稳定错误码表，22 个码，唯一声明处 `src/error-code.ts`，`source` 恒为 `'lifecycle'`：

rows: 相对延时无法注册、调度或清理；原错误保持可追溯，取消本身返回 false 而非错误
`close()` 之后调用 `own()`（异步/同步 scope）或某个 registry 的 `retain()`
容器已到达 `terminal` 之后，任何登记/激活操作
disposer 内部重入本 scope 的 `dispose()`
disposer 内部调用本 scope 的 `own()`
`SyncLifecycleScope` 收到 `syncSafe !== true` 的 descriptor、收到一个异步 scope 实例作为资源、或某回调返回了 thenable
`throw` 策略下释放失败：单个未分类失败会被附上此码，多个失败合成的 `AggregateError` 也带此码
由已不再导出的内部单元加载器使用
一次异步操作的结果在 `adopt()` 提交点已被更晚的 generation 取代（非失败信号，仅诊断）
generation 取消期间的 timer、parent listener 或 signal cleanup 失败
在已 `dispose()` 的 `GenerationController` 上调用 `begin()`
当前 generation 的 timeoutMs 预算到期；signal.reason 为带码 Error
未先 `seal(key)` 就调用严格 `whenZero(key)`（同步抛出，非 rejected Promise）
重复 commit、rollback 后 commit、成功 commit 后 rollback；重复 rollback 复用原 Promise
`commitTo()` 的目标 parent 已 `closing`/`terminal`，拒绝接收资源
mutation 在队列中等待超过配置的 `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs`
同一 `owner` 在自己尚未完成时又向同一队列提交新任务且被等待，会死锁
descriptor 的 `force` 抛出/reject（契约要求 `force` 必须无条件成功）
共享绝对 deadline 已过去，但仍有资源被要求进入新的 graceful 阶段；或同步 `graceful` 超过预算才返回（仍算成功，不跑 `force`）。两者都只经 `report` 上报，正常降级路径不用这个码
lifecycle 需要的宿主 `AbortController` 能力缺失；调度器宿主能力缺失由 utils `ENV_UNSUPPORTED` 报告
scheduler 收到非法时间/延迟参数，或 descriptor 字段类型非法

blocks.text: 逐条设计动机见源码 `src/error-code.ts` 的 JSDoc；调用方应始终以 `error.code === LifecycleErrorCode.xxx` 判别，不要硬编码码值字符串。

symbols.purpose: Names the four release-failure outcomes consumed by scopes, transactions and collectors. It changes failure delivery after attempts continue; it does not select release ordering or suppress later resource attempts.
symbols.core:
throw: Attempt every release, then throw one original error or a coded aggregate for several.
collect: Return every labeled original failure after all release attempts complete.
report: Report each failure and return an empty list; owners require a reporter.
firstError: Retain and throw the first original failure, report later ones; intended for legacy first-error migration.

symbols.purpose: Stable public diagnostic messages used when lifecycle constructs or wraps errors. Keys explain scenarios rather than remediation policy; branch on source and code instead of matching these strings.
symbols.core:
delayFailed: Fallback message for a delay failure whose original value needs a coded wrapper.
waitCleanupReporterInvalid: Reports a wait-cleanup reporter that is present but not callable.
provisionalCleanupFailed: Names the provisional cleanup boundary when secondary failures are attached.
disposeTransactionFailed: Aggregate release message supplied when the transaction finalizes several failures.
scopeReentrantDispose: Explains the forbidden attempt to join the scope currently waiting for its disposer.
disposeDescriptorInvalid: Identifies admission failure of a release descriptor or ledger callback shape.
cleanupResultInvalid: Reports a cleanup observation without the required `cleanupErrors` array.
syncGracefulOverBudget: Diagnostic only: synchronous graceful release returned after its deadline but still succeeded.
mutationAdmissionTimedOut: Fallback message for a queued admission timeout or its cleanup attribution.
generationCancellationFailed: Labels failed generation cancellation or completion cleanup while retaining original causes.
disposalLedgerClosed: Explains why a sealed ledger no longer accepts a new item callback.
disposalLedgerReentrant: Explains an admission or sealing attempt made inside the active ledger callback.
envUnsupported: Describes missing native host cancellation support required at construction.
abortSignalInvalid: Describes a cancellation signal without callable listener registration and removal methods.
schedulerTaskCancelGetterFailed: Describes a scheduled handle whose cancel accessor throws during admission.
schedulerTaskInvalid: Describes an invalid task handle returned by an injected scheduler.
schedulerAccessorFailed: Describes a thrown getter while capturing the selected scheduler or its methods.
schedulerDeferInvalid: Explains why an optional scheduler defer property must be callable when supplied.
schedulerInvalid: Explains that the scheduler requires callable clock and scheduling methods.
schedulerNumberType: Describes a time or delay value whose runtime type is not numeric.
schedulerNumberRange: Describes a numeric time or delay that is not finite.
schedulerDelayRange: Describes a delay whose finite numeric value is negative.
schedulerTimeOverflow: Describes addition that would make a scheduler time infinite.
errorPolicyReporterMissing: Explains the missing reporter for report or first-error release policies.
generationSupersededReason: Cancellation reason text when a new begin replaces the current generation.
generationTimedOutReason: Cancellation reason text when the current generation’s timeout budget expires.
unitDisposedReason: Cancellation reason text when disposal terminates a lifecycle unit’s active request.
scopeClosedReason: Cancellation reason text delivered to owned release callbacks by scope closure.
provisionalRolledBackReason: Cancellation reason text when a provisional scope chooses rollback.
provisionalCommittedReason: Cancellation reason text when provisional resources commit to their permanent owner.
quiescenceSealed: Explains a new lease request rejected by a sealed key.
quiescenceUnsealedWait: Explains the seal prerequisite for strict zero waiting and points to the loose alternative.
provisionalSettled: Explains provisional use after commit or rollback has already settled ownership.
provisionalParentClosed: Explains a failed commit whose parent refused ownership after closing.
unitStartFailed: Labels the original failure of a lifecycle unit’s start operation.
unitTerminal: Explains refusal of new work by a terminal lifecycle unit.
unitClosing: Explains refusal of new work by a closing lifecycle unit.
generationDisposed: Explains why a disposed generation controller cannot begin again.
generationSupersededBeforeAdopt: Diagnostic text when adoption discards a result from a stale token.
sharedDeadlinePassed: Diagnostic text when asynchronous graceful work cannot wait beyond the exhausted shared deadline.
releaseForceFailed: Diagnostic text when unconditional forced teardown fails.
syncCallbackReturnedThenable: Explains that a declared synchronous disposer returned an unsupported thenable.
scopeTerminal: Explains ownership refusal by an irreversibly terminal scope.
scopeClosing: Explains ownership refusal by a scope whose admission is already closed.
scopeReentrantOwn: Explains registration attempted from inside the same scope’s active disposer.
syncScopeRequiresSyncSafe: Explains the required explicit synchronization promise on each sync descriptor.
syncScopeOwnsAsyncOwner: Explains why a synchronous scope rejects asynchronous or provisional scope resources.
syncScopeDisposalFailed: Aggregate message when several synchronous releases fail.
generationTimeoutAccessorFailed: Explains a getter failure while reading the per-request timeout option.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Stable public diagnostic messages used when lifecycle constructs or wraps errors. Keys explain scenarios rather than remediation policy; branch on source and code instead of matching these strings.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import LifecycleErrorText from @migaia/lifecycle, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use LifecycleErrorText when its const contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when LifecycleErrorText does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained const example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
delayFailed: Fallback message for a delay failure whose original value needs a coded wrapper.
waitCleanupReporterInvalid: Reports a wait-cleanup reporter that is present but not callable.
provisionalCleanupFailed: Names the provisional cleanup boundary when secondary failures are attached.
disposeTransactionFailed: Aggregate release message supplied when the transaction finalizes several failures.
scopeReentrantDispose: Explains the forbidden attempt to join the scope currently waiting for its disposer.
disposeDescriptorInvalid: Identifies admission failure of a release descriptor or ledger callback shape.
cleanupResultInvalid: Reports a cleanup observation without the required `cleanupErrors` array.
syncGracefulOverBudget: Diagnostic only: synchronous graceful release returned after its deadline but still succeeded.
mutationAdmissionTimedOut: Fallback message for a queued admission timeout or its cleanup attribution.
generationCancellationFailed: Labels failed generation cancellation or completion cleanup while retaining original causes.
disposalLedgerClosed: Explains why a sealed ledger no longer accepts a new item callback.
disposalLedgerReentrant: Explains an admission or sealing attempt made inside the active ledger callback.
envUnsupported: Describes missing native host cancellation support required at construction.
abortSignalInvalid: Describes a cancellation signal without callable listener registration and removal methods.
schedulerTaskCancelGetterFailed: Describes a scheduled handle whose cancel accessor throws during admission.
schedulerTaskInvalid: Describes an invalid task handle returned by an injected scheduler.
schedulerAccessorFailed: Describes a thrown getter while capturing the selected scheduler or its methods.
schedulerDeferInvalid: Explains why an optional scheduler defer property must be callable when supplied.
schedulerInvalid: Explains that the scheduler requires callable clock and scheduling methods.
schedulerNumberType: Describes a time or delay value whose runtime type is not numeric.
schedulerNumberRange: Describes a numeric time or delay that is not finite.
schedulerDelayRange: Describes a delay whose finite numeric value is negative.
schedulerTimeOverflow: Describes addition that would make a scheduler time infinite.
errorPolicyReporterMissing: Explains the missing reporter for report or first-error release policies.
generationSupersededReason: Cancellation reason text when a new begin replaces the current generation.
generationTimedOutReason: Cancellation reason text when the current generation’s timeout budget expires.
unitDisposedReason: Cancellation reason text when disposal terminates a lifecycle unit’s active request.
scopeClosedReason: Cancellation reason text delivered to owned release callbacks by scope closure.
provisionalRolledBackReason: Cancellation reason text when a provisional scope chooses rollback.
provisionalCommittedReason: Cancellation reason text when provisional resources commit to their permanent owner.
quiescenceSealed: Explains a new lease request rejected by a sealed key.
quiescenceUnsealedWait: Explains the seal prerequisite for strict zero waiting and points to the loose alternative.
provisionalSettled: Explains provisional use after commit or rollback has already settled ownership.
provisionalParentClosed: Explains a failed commit whose parent refused ownership after closing.
unitStartFailed: Labels the original failure of a lifecycle unit’s start operation.
unitTerminal: Explains refusal of new work by a terminal lifecycle unit.
unitClosing: Explains refusal of new work by a closing lifecycle unit.
generationDisposed: Explains why a disposed generation controller cannot begin again.
generationSupersededBeforeAdopt: Diagnostic text when adoption discards a result from a stale token.
sharedDeadlinePassed: Diagnostic text when asynchronous graceful work cannot wait beyond the exhausted shared deadline.
releaseForceFailed: Diagnostic text when unconditional forced teardown fails.
syncCallbackReturnedThenable: Explains that a declared synchronous disposer returned an unsupported thenable.
scopeTerminal: Explains ownership refusal by an irreversibly terminal scope.
scopeClosing: Explains ownership refusal by a scope whose admission is already closed.
scopeReentrantOwn: Explains registration attempted from inside the same scope’s active disposer.
syncScopeRequiresSyncSafe: Explains the required explicit synchronization promise on each sync descriptor.
syncScopeOwnsAsyncOwner: Explains why a synchronous scope rejects asynchronous or provisional scope resources.
syncScopeDisposalFailed: Aggregate message when several synchronous releases fail.
generationTimeoutAccessorFailed: Explains a getter failure while reading the per-request timeout option.

symbols.purpose: Names the three irreversible resource-container survival states, independently of a unit’s loading status. Owners use these values to decide whether registration or terminal waiting remains possible.
symbols.core:
open: Accept resources or work; no close transition has occurred yet.
closing: Reject new ownership while cleanup may still be pending.
terminal: Irreversibly finished; no future registration or restart is allowed.
parameters: This const declaration has no parameters.
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this const.

blocks.text: 本包委托当前宿主的原生 `AbortController`，返回真实 host instance（结构上与 DOM/Node 的 `AbortSignal` 兼容，可互相传递）：

无构造参数，也不接受 custom factory。实际对象由当前 realm 的 host-owned `globalThis.AbortController` 构造；lifecycle 不返回 facade、Proxy 或自建 EventTarget。宿主 constructor 缺失、getter throw、不可构造、构造失败或结果不满足最小 controller/signal shape时，抛保留原始 cause 的 `ENV_UNSUPPORTED`。
需要注意的行为：

items: `abort()` 与 `abort(undefined)` 使用宿主默认 reason，通常是原生 `DOMException`（name 为 `AbortError`），而不是 `undefined`。
non-`undefined` explicit reason保持 `===` identity；把 structural parent signal 的 `undefined` reason转发给native child时，同样规范化为宿主 `AbortError`。
重复 `abort()` 幂等，不覆盖第一次固化的 reason。
外部 listener throw走宿主 EventTarget error channel；`try/catch controller.abort()` 不能同步捕获它，lifecycle也不再提供 `ABORT_LISTENER_FAILED`。

Lifecycle 自己登记的 parent/cancellation callback 经过 module-private observed-subscription：处理 already-aborted、registration-time abort、post-registration recheck和幂等remove，并把自身 callback/read/cleanup failure交给对应 operation的collect/report边界。它不代理、枚举或捕获同一 signal 上的外部 listener。

blocks.text: 如果业务需要旧式“listener错误由调用 abort 的栈聚合抛出”，应使用业务自己拥有的回调编排器；不要包裹或 monkey-patch native `AbortSignal`。

symbols.purpose: Owns one abort subscription using captured listener methods and an immediate post-registration state check. Delivery happens at most once; callback and removal failures go to the owner rather than native event dispatch.
symbols.core:
signal: An `IAbortSignal` from a controller or parent operation, with callable add/remove listener methods; already-aborted sources are delivered immediately.
callback: Synchronous `(reason) => void`; reason comes from `signal.reason`, or its getter failure. Its return is ignored and synchronous throws go to `onFailure`; returned promises are not observed here.
onFailure: Synchronous `(error) => void` owner sink for callback, reason-access and listener-removal failures. Its return is ignored and synchronous sink throws are contained.
An `IObservedAbortSubscription` for explicit idempotent unsubscription and registration-cleanup retry. Invalid listener methods throw `INVALID_OPTION`; registration failures retain their original identity.

symbols.name: createDisposeTransaction
symbols.signature: export declare function createDisposeTransaction(mode: IDisposeTransactionMode, options?: IDisposeTransactionOptions): IDisposeTransaction;
symbols.purpose: Builds a reusable sequential release executor with one fixed ordering mode and error policy. Every run admits all descriptors before invoking callbacks, releases valid items despite other failures, then drains optional pending work.
symbols.core:
mode: Caller-authored `IDisposeTransactionMode`: `order` stably sorts descending priorities; `plan` preserves the supplied sequence and never reads priorities.
An `IDisposeTransaction`; missing required reporters and invalid schedulers fail construction with `INVALID_OPTION`.
errorPolicy: Selects the release error outcome from `LifecycleErrorPolicy`. Every admitted item still receives its release attempt; `report` and `firstError` require a reporter when creating a scope or transaction.
`throw`: rethrow one original failure or aggregate several after release.
Keep default throw to propagate release failures. Choose collect to inspect a returned list, report to deliver every failure to a required reporter, or firstError to throw the first and report later ones. Every item still receives its release attempt.
report: Receives each diagnostic or policy-routed `error` from lifecycle. Return nothing synchronously; accidental thenable rejections and synchronous throws are contained. A scope or transaction requires this callback for `report` and `firstError` policies.
report.error: Original failure or coded diagnostic supplied by the current lifecycle operation.
No value is consumed; callback failures do not replace the operation result.
Omitted: diagnostics have no sink; factories reject this omission for `report` and `firstError`.
Supply a synchronous receiver when cleanup failures must reach monitoring. It is required with report or firstError policies; omission otherwise provides no diagnostic sink. Return no value; reporter failures are contained.
deadlineAt: Absolute finite time in the selected scheduler clock. Every item sees the same `deadlineAt`; it caps graceful waiting only, so forced release can continue beyond it.
Omitted: no shared deadline; an individual descriptor may still set its own graceful budget.
scheduler: Clock and timer implementation from `@migaia/utils/scheduler`. Supply the same scheduler that produced every absolute deadline; lifecycle snapshots methods with their original receiver and rejects invalid shapes with `INVALID_OPTION`.
Omitted: use the admitted `systemScheduler` when a timed phase first needs it.
signal: Caller-owned `IAbortSignal` mirrored into a private per-run native signal; running the transaction never aborts the input controller.
Omitted: every item receives an inert non-aborting signal.
disposer: Owner-bound `IDisposerContext` supplied by an owning scope; generic callers normally omit this capability.
Omitted: no scope self-join capability is placed in the context.
pending: Caller-owned object with async no-argument `drain()` invoked after all release items; fulfillment means pending work drained, and rejection becomes a transaction-pending failure.
Omitted: no final pending-work drain is run.
pending.drain: Caller-provided no-argument callback invoked after all release items; return a Promise<void> that settles when pending work drains. Synchronous throws or rejection become transaction-pending failures.
Supply it when releases start work that must settle after all items. Return Promise<void>; rejection becomes a transaction-pending failure. Omitting pending skips this final drain.
parameters: mode: IDisposeTransactionMode
options: IDisposeTransactionOptions (optional)
symbols.returns: IDisposeTransaction

blocks.text: 编排多个资源的释放，`order` 弱排序或 `plan` 强序列二选一，同一实例不能混用：
边界行为：

items: `{ kind: 'order' }`：按每个 item 的 `descriptor.order`（缺省 `0`）降序分组释放，稳定排序保留同序调用方给定的相对顺序；只在此模式读取 `order`。
`{ kind: 'plan' }`：严格按 `items` 给定顺序执行，从不读取 `order` 字段。
`signal?`：转发进每个 item 的 `context.signal`；`run()` 开始时自动镜像调用方传入信号的中止状态；无 `signal` 时 item 收到一个永不中止的惰性信号。
`deadlineAt`/`scheduler`：本次 `run()` 内所有 item 共享，不逐 item 重算。
`pending?`：全部 item 释放完后仅一次调用 `pending.drain()` 等待其触发的在途工作排空（典型传 `createPendingTracker()`）。
descriptor 校验（`order`/`custom`/`graceful`/`gracefulTimeoutMs`/`force` 的类型与访问）逐项独立进行——一个 item 的非法 descriptor（贴 `INVALID_OPTION` 码）不阻断其余 item 的释放，会作为该 item 的失败计入错误策略。
`errorPolicy` 语义同 `createErrorCollector`；`throw` 策略下单错保留原生实例并给未分类错误附 `SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED`，primitive 通过 cause 包装；已有合法外部身份不变。多错聚合为携带 `SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED` 码的 `AggregateError`。

blocks.text: 按四种错误策略收集/上报错误，`createDisposeTransaction`/`createSyncLifecycleScope` 内部都用它：

`policy`、`report`（必填，`throw`/`collect` 可显式传 `undefined`；`report`/`firstError` 必须提供函数，否则创建时抛 `INVALID_OPTION`）。`add(source, error)` 按策略即时处理（`'report'` 策略立即调用 `report`；`'firstError'` 只记住第一个错误，其余经 `report` 观测）。`finalize(message)`：`'collect'` 返回收集到的数组；`'report'` 返回空数组（已在 `add` 时上报）；`'throw'` 单错保留原生实例并给未分类错误附 `SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED`，primitive 通过 cause 包装；已有合法外部身份不变。多错聚合成携带 `SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED` 码的 `AggregateError`；`'firstError'` 有错误时抛首个，否则返回空数组。

blocks.text: 用于“同步启动全部 disposer，但异步统一等待”的领域容器。Ledger 是 pending、raw error 与 terminal 的唯一事实源；调用方仍负责生成顺序计划、清空领域 registry，以及把 raw errors 投影成自己的 throw/report/aggregate 契约。
状态和 identity：

items: 初始 `open`；`start()` 不改变 lifecycle。
首次 `seal()` 同步进入 `closing`，冻结当时已经观察到的全部错误，并返回唯一 outcome；重复 `seal()` 返回同一对象，`outcome.physicalCompletion` 也保持同一 Promise。
已 seal 且 `pending === 0` 时进入 `terminal`；否则最后一个 thenable settle 后进入 `terminal`。`whenTerminal()` 只表达 terminal 等待，不承诺 Promise 对象 identity。
合法 thenable 永不 settle 时保持 `closing`；Ledger 不自造 timeout、abort、retry 或强制 terminal。

blocks.text: Callback 与 thenable：

items: `start()` 先校验 `source` 为 string、`callback` 为 function；非法输入同步抛 `INVALID_OPTION`，且不调用 callback。
callback 同步 throw 或读取 `.then` getter throw：记录进 seal 时的 `cleanupErrors` 快照；`start()` 不重抛 item failure，因此调用方仍能启动后续 item。
thenable 的 `.then` 只读取一次，并以原 thenable 为 receiver 调用；resolve/reject first-settlement-wins。Rejection按 settlement observation order进入最终 ledger。
每条错误是冻结的 `{ source, error }`；原始 `error` identity不被 Ledger替换。`physicalCompletion` 因 item failure也不会 reject，避免 Ledger抢走领域错误政策。

blocks.text: 重入和关闭边界：

items: 当前 item callback/thenable probe 尚未结束时重入 `start()` 或 `seal()`，同步抛 `SCOPE_REENTRANT_OWN`（`disposalLedgerReentrant` 文案）；外层 `start()` 把它当作当前 item 的同步 failure收集。
seal 后再 `start()` 同步抛 `SCOPE_CLOSED`（`disposalLedgerClosed` 文案），不调用新 callback。
Ledger 没有 rollback：进入 closing 后只能等待 admitted thenables settle。

blocks.text: 错误政策边界：Ledger 固定采用 raw `collect`。`firstError` 是最终 ledger 的第一条 observation；`throw`、`report`、`AggregateError` message/source/code和reporter failure containment全部属于调用 adapter，不应反向写入 Ledger。

signal: Caller-owned `IAbortSignal` mirrored into a private per-run native signal; running the transaction never aborts the input controller.

`mergeCleanupResults` observes current cleanup snapshots and their later physical continuations. Each continuation contains only newly observed errors. It accepts PromiseLike values across realms, retains original rejection identities, and merges branches in input order without discarding successful or failed siblings. Domain state stays with its owner.

blocks.text: 稳定错误码表，22 个码，唯一声明处 `src/error-code.ts`，`source` 恒为 `'lifecycle'`：

rows: 相对延时无法注册、调度或清理；原错误保持可追溯，取消本身返回 false 而非错误
`close()` 之后调用 `own()`（异步/同步 scope）或某个 registry 的 `retain()`
容器已到达 `terminal` 之后，任何登记/激活操作
disposer 内部重入本 scope 的 `dispose()`
disposer 内部调用本 scope 的 `own()`
`SyncLifecycleScope` 收到 `syncSafe !== true` 的 descriptor、收到一个异步 scope 实例作为资源、或某回调返回了 thenable
`throw` 策略下释放失败：单个未分类失败会被附上此码，多个失败合成的 `AggregateError` 也带此码
由已不再导出的内部单元加载器使用
一次异步操作的结果在 `adopt()` 提交点已被更晚的 generation 取代（非失败信号，仅诊断）
generation 取消期间的 timer、parent listener 或 signal cleanup 失败
在已 `dispose()` 的 `GenerationController` 上调用 `begin()`
当前 generation 的 timeoutMs 预算到期；signal.reason 为带码 Error
未先 `seal(key)` 就调用严格 `whenZero(key)`（同步抛出，非 rejected Promise）
重复 commit、rollback 后 commit、成功 commit 后 rollback；重复 rollback 复用原 Promise
`commitTo()` 的目标 parent 已 `closing`/`terminal`，拒绝接收资源
mutation 在队列中等待超过配置的 `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs`
同一 `owner` 在自己尚未完成时又向同一队列提交新任务且被等待，会死锁
descriptor 的 `force` 抛出/reject（契约要求 `force` 必须无条件成功）
共享绝对 deadline 已过去，但仍有资源被要求进入新的 graceful 阶段；或同步 `graceful` 超过预算才返回（仍算成功，不跑 `force`）。两者都只经 `report` 上报，正常降级路径不用这个码
lifecycle 需要的宿主 `AbortController` 能力缺失；调度器宿主能力缺失由 utils `ENV_UNSUPPORTED` 报告
scheduler 收到非法时间/延迟参数，或 descriptor 字段类型非法

blocks.text: 逐条设计动机见源码 `src/error-code.ts` 的 JSDoc；调用方应始终以 `error.code === LifecycleErrorCode.xxx` 判别，不要硬编码码值字符串。

symbols.core:

parentSignal: An `IAbortSignal` from the parent owner; cancellation invalidates the active token. Non-undefined reasons retain identity; undefined is normalized to the host-native AbortError. Parent cleanup failures go to `report` once.
Omitted: generations do not subscribe to an external parent.
scheduler: Clock and timer implementation from `@migaia/utils/scheduler`. Supply the same scheduler that produced every absolute deadline; lifecycle snapshots methods with their original receiver and rejects invalid shapes with `INVALID_OPTION`.
Omitted: use the admitted `systemScheduler` when a timed phase first needs it.
onSuperseded: Synchronous `(info) => void` diagnostic called before releasing a stale adopted result. The supplied `ILifecycleError` has `GENERATION_SUPERSEDED`; its return is ignored, synchronous throws and asynchronous rejections go to the existing `report` boundary. No value is consumed; accidental asynchronous rejection is observed through `report`.
Omitted: discarded adoption produces no superseded diagnostic callback.

report.error: Original failure or coded diagnostic supplied by the current lifecycle operation.
No value is consumed; callback failures do not replace the operation result.
Omitted: these last-boundary failures have no reporting sink.
Set it to observe stale-result release failures or asynchronous generation cleanup failures without a per-call receiver. Omission drops those last-boundary diagnostics; adoption still returns its own result.

declaredConfiguration.description: When this aborts, the currently-active generation's `signal` aborts too.

declaredConfiguration.name: onSuperseded
declaredConfiguration.description: Diagnostic channel fired from `adopt()` whenever `token` is no longer current — before the release attempt, regardless of whether it succeeds. function createGenerationController(options?: IGenerationControllerOptions): IGenerationController

type IGenerationControllerOptions = {
  readonly parentSignal?: IAbortSignal
  readonly onSuperseded?: (info: ILifecycleError) => void
  readonly scheduler?: IScheduler // 默认 systemScheduler
  readonly report?: (error: unknown) => void
}

type IGenerationToken = object

type IGenerationRequest = {
  readonly generation: number
  readonly token: IGenerationToken
  readonly signal: IAbortSignal
}

type IGenerationController = {
  readonly generation: number
  readonly disposed: boolean
  begin(options?: { readonly timeoutMs?: number }): IGenerationRequest
  isCurrent(token: IGenerationToken): boolean
  complete(token: IGenerationToken): boolean
  supersede(reason?: unknown): void
  adopt<T>(
    token: IGenerationToken,
    value: T,
    release: (value: T) => void | PromiseLike<void>,
    onReleaseError?: (error: unknown) => void
  ): boolean
  dispose(reason?: unknown): void
}

blocks.text: 代数 + 每代一个 `AbortSignal`，新一代自动使旧一代失效：
边界行为：

items: `begin(options?)`：使当前活跃代（若存在）立即失效（触发其 `signal` 中止），`generation` 自增，返回新的 `{ generation, token, signal }`。`options.timeoutMs?` 非法（非有限/负数）抛 `INVALID_OPTION`；超过该毫秒数后当前代的 `signal` 自动中止。控制器已 `dispose()` 后调用抛 `GENERATION_DISPOSED`。
`isCurrent(token)`：`token` 是否仍是当前代；`dispose()` 之后恒为 `false`。
`supersede(reason?)`：作废当前代（其 `signal` 中止）但控制器本身仍可用，之后 `begin()` 仍能开新代；对已 `dispose()` 的控制器调用是空操作。

`complete(token)`：只释放匹配的当前代，返回 true 并使 token 不再 current；先清 timer、再移除 parent listener，保持 signal 未中止。stale/disposed token 返回 false，不影响当前代。cleanup 失败仍以原 `GENERATION_CANCELLATION_FAILED` 保留原 cause，失败后 token 已作废；后续 `begin()` 仍可用。真正取消继续使用 `supersede`/parent/timeout/dispose，保持原 signal 与 reason。

`adopt(token, value, release, onReleaseError?)`：`token` 仍是当前代时返回 `true`，`value` 留给调用方；否则调用 `release(value)` 回收并返回 `false`——`release` 本身抛出/reject 只会经 `onReleaseError` 上报，绝不反过来污染"当前是哪一代"这一状态（不会抛出、不会重新计入错误策略）。若提供了 `onSuperseded`，在过期路径上先额外触发一次携带 `GENERATION_SUPERSEDED` 码的诊断信息（非失败信号）。
`dispose(reason?)`：终态；之后 `begin()` 恒抛 `GENERATION_DISPOSED`，`isCurrent()` 恒 `false`。
`parentSignal` 中止时，当前活跃代同步中止（清理 timer、移除 parent listener、abort 自身 controller）；清理过程中任一步失败会聚合为 `GENERATION_CANCELLATION_FAILED`。

symbols.signature: export type IGenerationController = { readonly generation: number; readonly disposed: boolean; /** * Starts a new generation, superseding whatever was active. Optionally auto-aborts after * `timeoutMs`. */ begin(options?: { readonly timeoutMs?: number; }): IGenerationRequest; isCurrent(token: IGenerationToken): boolean; /** * Releases the matching current token's timer and parent subscription without aborting its * signal. symbols.purpose: Single-active-generation controller returned by `createGenerationController()`; stale results never regain ownership by matching a numeric counter alone.
symbols.core:
generation: Monotonically advanced counter for begins, supersedes and first disposal; it is diagnostic, while token identity decides currency.
disposed: Whether disposal has permanently closed this controller; a disposed controller cannot begin another generation.
begin: Invalidates the previous token and aborts its signal before creating a new request. Pair with `adopt()` or `isCurrent()` when accepting the eventual result.
begin.options: Optional object with `timeoutMs`: finite nonnegative per-generation milliseconds. Omitted timeout means no timer; a supplied invalid value throws `INVALID_OPTION` before replacing the old generation.
An `IGenerationRequest` with a fresh token, captured generation and native signal. A disposed controller throws `GENERATION_DISPOSED`; cancellation cleanup may throw `GENERATION_CANCELLATION_FAILED`.
isCurrent: Checks exact active token identity and controller liveness without changing state or refreshing the timeout.
isCurrent.token: Token returned by this controller’s `begin()` request, not a caller-created object or generation number.
True only while this exact token remains active and the controller is not disposed.
complete: Invalidates a matching token and cleans its timer and parent subscription without aborting the completed request’s signal.
complete.token: Exact token returned by the request created through this controller’s `begin()`.
True after completing the active token, false for stale/disposed tokens. Cleanup failure may throw after invalidation.
supersede: Invalidates and aborts the active generation without permanently disposing the controller; the caller may begin fresh work later.
supersede.reason: Optional caller-issued cancellation value forwarded unchanged to the active signal; omitted uses native abort semantics.
The current token is invalid and its owned timer/listener are released; cleanup failure can throw. A disposed controller does nothing.
adopt: Accepts a result only for the current token. Pair with `begin()`; stale values are released immediately, with asynchronous release rejection observed independently of newer work.
adopt.token: Token returned in the original `begin()` request that produced this result.
adopt.value: Result produced by caller-owned asynchronous work, passed unchanged to the stale-release callback.
adopt.release: Caller-authored `(value) => void | PromiseLike<void>` that releases only a stale result. The value is this adoption input; throws/rejections go to the selected release-error reporter.
adopt.onReleaseError: Optional synchronous `(error) => void` receiving the release failure; omitted uses the controller reporter. Return ignored; throws and rejections are contained.
True when the caller keeps the current result, false when stale release was attempted; false does not wait for asynchronous release.
dispose: Permanently prevents new generations and invalidates the active token before releasing cancellation resources; repeated calls do nothing.
dispose.reason: Optional caller-issued abort reason forwarded to the active request; omitted follows native abort semantics.
The controller is disposed and its active request aborted; cancellation cleanup failure can throw after state convergence.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
generation: Monotonically advanced counter for begins, supersedes and first disposal; it is diagnostic, while token identity decides currency.
disposed: Whether disposal has permanently closed this controller; a disposed controller cannot begin another generation.
begin: Invalidates the previous token and aborts its signal before creating a new request. Pair with `adopt()` or `isCurrent()` when accepting the eventual result.
begin.options: Optional object with `timeoutMs`: finite nonnegative per-generation milliseconds. Omitted timeout means no timer; a supplied invalid value throws `INVALID_OPTION` before replacing the old generation.
An `IGenerationRequest` with a fresh token, captured generation and native signal. A disposed controller throws `GENERATION_DISPOSED`; cancellation cleanup may throw `GENERATION_CANCELLATION_FAILED`.
isCurrent: Checks exact active token identity and controller liveness without changing state or refreshing the timeout.
isCurrent.token: Token returned by this controller’s `begin()` request, not a caller-created object or generation number.
True only while this exact token remains active and the controller is not disposed.
complete: Invalidates a matching token and cleans its timer and parent subscription without aborting the completed request’s signal.
complete.token: Exact token returned by the request created through this controller’s `begin()`.
True after completing the active token, false for stale/disposed tokens. Cleanup failure may throw after invalidation.
supersede: Invalidates and aborts the active generation without permanently disposing the controller; the caller may begin fresh work later.
supersede.reason: Optional caller-issued cancellation value forwarded unchanged to the active signal; omitted uses native abort semantics.
The current token is invalid and its owned timer/listener are released; cleanup failure can throw. A disposed controller does nothing.
adopt: Accepts a result only for the current token. Pair with `begin()`; stale values are released immediately, with asynchronous release rejection observed independently of newer work.
adopt.token: Token returned in the original `begin()` request that produced this result.
adopt.value: Result produced by caller-owned asynchronous work, passed unchanged to the stale-release callback.
adopt.release: Caller-authored `(value) => void | PromiseLike<void>` that releases only a stale result. The value is this adoption input; throws/rejections go to the selected release-error reporter.
adopt.onReleaseError: Optional synchronous `(error) => void` receiving the release failure; omitted uses the controller reporter. Return ignored; throws and rejections are contained.
True when the caller keeps the current result, false when stale release was attempted; false does not wait for asynchronous release.
dispose: Permanently prevents new generations and invalidates the active token before releasing cancellation resources; repeated calls do nothing.
dispose.reason: Optional caller-issued abort reason forwarded to the active request; omitted follows native abort semantics.
The controller is disposed and its active request aborted; cancellation cleanup failure can throw after state convergence.

blocks.text: 把任意 duck-typed 值快照成标准 `IScheduler`（校验并锁定 accessor，防止 hostile getter 二次读取）：

blocks.code: const snap = snapshotScheduler(candidate) // 不是合法 scheduler 时返回 undefined，而不是抛错

blocks.text: 单参数 `value: unknown`，无选项；`now`/`schedule` 都不是函数时返回 `undefined`；读取 `now`/`schedule` 属性本身抛错时抛 `TypeError`（`INVALID_OPTION`）。快照的 `schedule()` 先以 `validateSchedulerDelay` 校验延迟，再调用注入的 `schedule`，然后按 `cancel`、`unref` 的顺序各读一次返回任务的访问器：`cancel` 缺失或不是函数时抛 `INVALID_OPTION`；`unref` 为函数时快照任务带 `unref()` 并以原任务为接收者转发，缺省时快照不含 `unref`；`unref` 读取抛出（原生 `TypeError`，原值在 `cause`）或不是函数时抛 `INVALID_OPTION`，且在抛出前先调用已读到的 `cancel` 回滚注入方已启动的 timer；回滚本身失败时，主错误不变，回滚错误挂在主错误的 `errors` 上。

内部/自定义 scheduler 实现复用的边界解析函数：`resolveScheduler(value)` 对非法值抛 `SCHEDULER_INVALID` 文案的 `INVALID_OPTION` 错误（而不是像 `snapshotScheduler` 那样返回 `undefined`）；`resolveSchedulerOption(options, fallback?)` 读取 `options.scheduler`，未提供时返回 `fallback`（若调用形态未传 `fallback` 则返回 `undefined`），读取该属性本身抛错时抛 `TypeError`（`INVALID_OPTION`）。

symbols.purpose: Creates an asynchronous resource owner with explicit release descriptors, descending release priority and reverse-registration tie order. Closing stops admission; disposal releases resources and always converges to terminal state.
symbols.core:
An `ILifecycleScope`; repeated external disposal calls return the same promise. Invalid scheduler or a required missing reporter throws `INVALID_OPTION`.
errorPolicy: Selects the release error outcome from `LifecycleErrorPolicy`. Every admitted item still receives its release attempt; `report` and `firstError` require a reporter when creating a scope or transaction.
`throw`: rethrow one original failure or aggregate several after release.
Keep default throw to propagate release failures. Choose collect to inspect a returned list, report to deliver every failure to a required reporter, or firstError to throw the first and report later ones. Every item still receives its release attempt.
report: Receives each diagnostic or policy-routed `error` from lifecycle. Return nothing synchronously; accidental thenable rejections and synchronous throws are contained. A scope or transaction requires this callback for `report` and `firstError` policies.
report.error: Original failure or coded diagnostic supplied by the current lifecycle operation.
No value is consumed; callback failures do not replace the operation result.
Omitted: diagnostics have no sink; factories reject this omission for `report` and `firstError`.
Supply a synchronous receiver when cleanup failures must reach monitoring. It is required with report or firstError policies; omission otherwise provides no diagnostic sink. Return no value; reporter failures are contained.
deadlineAt: Absolute finite time in the selected scheduler clock. Every item sees the same `deadlineAt`; it caps graceful waiting only, so forced release can continue beyond it.
Omitted: no shared deadline; an individual descriptor may still set its own graceful budget.
scheduler: Clock and timer implementation from `@migaia/utils/scheduler`. Supply the same scheduler that produced every absolute deadline; lifecycle snapshots methods with their original receiver and rejects invalid shapes with `INVALID_OPTION`.
Omitted: use the admitted `systemScheduler` when a timed phase first needs it.
parameters: options: ILifecycleScopeOptions (optional)

blocks.code:
function createLifecycleScope(options?: ILifecycleScopeOptions): ILifecycleScope

type ILifecycleScopeOptions = {
  readonly errorPolicy?: 'throw' | 'collect' | 'report' | 'firstError' // 默认 'throw'
  readonly report?: (error: unknown) => void
  readonly deadlineAt?: number
  readonly scheduler?: IScheduler // 默认 systemScheduler
}

type ILifecycleScope = ILifecycleOwner & {
  readonly lifecycle: 'open' | 'closing' | 'terminal'
  own<T>(resource: T, descriptor: IReleaseDescriptor): T
  release(resource: unknown): boolean
  close(): void
  dispose(): Promise<readonly ICollectedError[]>
  [Symbol.asyncDispose](): Promise<void> // await using；丢弃收集到的错误结果
}

blocks.text: 通用异步所有权容器：
边界行为：

items: `own(resource, descriptor)`：容器处于 `closing`/`terminal` 时抛 `SCOPE_CLOSED`/`SCOPE_TERMINAL`；在 disposer 内部重入调用抛 `SCOPE_REENTRANT_OWN`；descriptor 形状非法（`order`/`custom`/`graceful`/`gracefulTimeoutMs`/`force`，规则同 dispose 时的 descriptor 校验）时在注册时就抛 `INVALID_OPTION`，访问器抛错则原样抛出。
`release(resource)`：反注册但不释放（调用方已自行释放），返回是否找到并移除了该条目；若曾设置 `gcFallback`，同时 unregister 对应的 `FinalizationRegistry` 条目。
`close()`：同步、幂等；`open → closing`。

`dispose()`：逆序（LIFO）释放全部已注册资源；并发多次调用复用同一个 Promise；需要在 disposer 中表达 owner self-join 时使用 `context.disposer.join()`，该操作抛 `SCOPE_REENTRANT_DISPOSE` 且不改变 canonical Promise；容器已 `terminal` 时仍返回首次 dispose Promise，保留原结果或 rejection。`errorPolicy: 'collect'` 时返回值为收集到的 `ICollectedError[]`；其余三种策略要么抛出要么内部上报，返回空数组。
提供 `[Symbol.asyncDispose](): Promise<void>`，可直接用于 `await using`（TypeScript 需包含 `ESNext.Disposable` 类型库）。

guidance.id: 方法调用-descriptor-与-options-的读取时机
guidance.heading: 方法调用、descriptor 与 options 的读取时机

blocks.text: `createLifecycleScope`、`createSyncLifecycleScope`、`createProvisionalScope` 和 `createMutationQueue` 返回的对象，方法都定义在原型上，必须通过对象调用（`scope.own(...)`、`queue.enqueue(...)`）。把方法解构出来单独调用（`const { own } = scope`）不受支持。
`own()` 校验 descriptor 时会保存一份快照，释放时使用的就是这份快照：注册之后再修改 descriptor 对象，或 getter 之后返回不同的值，都不会影响释放。provisional scope 在 `commitTo(parent)` 时仍把原 descriptor 交给 `parent.own()`，由父 scope 自己校验和快照。
options（`errorPolicy`、`report`、`deadlineAt`、`scheduler`、`onAdmissionDiagnostic` 等）只在创建时读取一次，之后不会再读。
释放回调收到的 `context.signal` 在第一次读取时才创建（已经处于 aborted 状态，reason 为 `SCOPE_CLOSED`）；provisional scope 没有传 `parentSignal` 时，它的 `signal` 也是第一次读取时才创建。不读取 signal 的释放回调不会产生 AbortController。

symbols.name: ILifecycleScope
symbols.signature: export type ILifecycleScope = ILifecycleOwner & { readonly lifecycle: ILifecycleState; /** Unregisters a resource without releasing it — the caller has already released it independently. */ release(resource: unknown): boolean; /** Synchronous, idempotent, never calls user code. */ close(): void; /** * Always asynchronous — there is no synchronous `dispose()` on this type. Resolves to the * collected errors for the `collect` policy (empty for the other three, which throw/report * internally instead). * * Concurrent external calls reuse the same published Promise even while release is in flight. * Only a synchronous call from an active disposer callback is rejected as reentrant, preventing * that callback from self-awaiting the Promise it is currently helping to settle. */ dispose(): Promise<readonly ICollectedError[]>; /** Awaits scope release for `await using`, discarding the collected-error result. */ [Symbol.asyncDispose](): Promise<void>; };
symbols.purpose: Asynchronous resource owner returned by `createLifecycleScope()`, with distinct admission-close and release-completion phases.
symbols.core:
own: Registers one resource and an explicit release descriptor while the owner is open. The same resource identity may be registered more than once; no resource method is discovered automatically.
own.resource: Value allocated by the caller; keep this exact identity for a later unregister operation.
own.descriptor: Caller-authored `IReleaseDescriptor` declaring required `force` and optional graceful/custom release callbacks. Invalid fields fail registration.
The exact `resource` unchanged; closed and terminal owners throw `SCOPE_CLOSED` or `SCOPE_TERMINAL`.
release: Removes the earliest active registration of a resource without calling its descriptor. Use after independently releasing it; repeated calls can remove separate registrations of the same value.
release.resource: The exact resource identity previously passed to this scope’s `own()`.
`true` if one registration was removed; `false` if none remains.
lifecycle: Current survival state from `LifecycleState`; closing forbids new work and terminal is irreversible.
close: Stops ownership registration synchronously and aborts the scope’s closing signal with `SCOPE_CLOSED`; no resource release callback is invoked here.
Admission is closed; call `dispose()` to perform resource release.
dispose: Closes admission and releases the stable resource snapshot by descending priority with reverse-registration ties. External repeated calls share one promise; synchronous self-disposal throws `SCOPE_REENTRANT_DISPOSE`.
A promise of collected errors for `collect`, empty for other successful policies. Throw/first-error policies reject after release; the scope still reaches terminal.
[Symbol.asyncDispose]: Supports `await using` by awaiting the same asynchronous disposal and discarding its collected-error return value.
A `Promise<void>` settling with disposal; thrown-policy failures still reject.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Caller-owned configuration for asynchronous scope failure delivery and shared release timing.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import ILifecycleScopeOptions from @migaia/lifecycle/scope, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use ILifecycleScopeOptions when its type contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when ILifecycleScopeOptions does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained type example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
errorPolicy: Selects the release error outcome from `LifecycleErrorPolicy`. Every admitted item still receives its release attempt; `report` and `firstError` require a reporter when creating a scope or transaction.
`throw`: rethrow one original failure or aggregate several after release.
Keep default throw to propagate release failures. Choose collect to inspect a returned list, report to deliver every failure to a required reporter, or firstError to throw the first and report later ones. Every item still receives its release attempt.
report: Receives each diagnostic or policy-routed `error` from lifecycle. Return nothing synchronously; accidental thenable rejections and synchronous throws are contained. A scope or transaction requires this callback for `report` and `firstError` policies.
report.error: Original failure or coded diagnostic supplied by the current lifecycle operation.
No value is consumed; callback failures do not replace the operation result.
Omitted: diagnostics have no sink; factories reject this omission for `report` and `firstError`.
Supply a synchronous receiver when cleanup failures must reach monitoring. It is required with report or firstError policies; omission otherwise provides no diagnostic sink. Return no value; reporter failures are contained.
deadlineAt: Absolute finite time in the selected scheduler clock. Every item sees the same `deadlineAt`; it caps graceful waiting only, so forced release can continue beyond it.
Omitted: no shared deadline; an individual descriptor may still set its own graceful budget.
scheduler: Clock and timer implementation from `@migaia/utils/scheduler`. Supply the same scheduler that produced every absolute deadline; lifecycle snapshots methods with their original receiver and rejects invalid shapes with `INVALID_OPTION`.
Omitted: use the admitted `systemScheduler` when a timed phase first needs it.

blocks.text: 通用异步所有权容器：
边界行为：

items: `own(resource, descriptor)`：容器处于 `closing`/`terminal` 时抛 `SCOPE_CLOSED`/`SCOPE_TERMINAL`；在 disposer 内部重入调用抛 `SCOPE_REENTRANT_OWN`；descriptor 形状非法（`order`/`custom`/`graceful`/`gracefulTimeoutMs`/`force`，规则同 dispose 时的 descriptor 校验）时在注册时就抛 `INVALID_OPTION`，访问器抛错则原样抛出。
`release(resource)`：反注册但不释放（调用方已自行释放），返回是否找到并移除了该条目；若曾设置 `gcFallback`，同时 unregister 对应的 `FinalizationRegistry` 条目。
`close()`：同步、幂等；`open → closing`。

`dispose()`：逆序（LIFO）释放全部已注册资源；并发多次调用复用同一个 Promise；需要在 disposer 中表达 owner self-join 时使用 `context.disposer.join()`，该操作抛 `SCOPE_REENTRANT_DISPOSE` 且不改变 canonical Promise；容器已 `terminal` 时仍返回首次 dispose Promise，保留原结果或 rejection。`errorPolicy: 'collect'` 时返回值为收集到的 `ICollectedError[]`；其余三种策略要么抛出要么内部上报，返回空数组。
提供 `[Symbol.asyncDispose](): Promise<void>`，可直接用于 `await using`（TypeScript 需包含 `ESNext.Disposable` 类型库）。
